summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit press release providing an operational update on its Fenn-Gib Gold Project in Northern Ontario. The update covers first quarter 2026 progress on environmental baseline studies, project notification, environmental assessment mandate award to Egis Canada Ltd., Highway 101 realignment scoping, and site investigations. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine operational progress report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. What to watch: permitting milestones toward a potential 2028 construction decision.
